identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
principles: Fusion over Imitation: CLI aesthetics in a GUI wrapper
Content is King: Data density over whitespace
Negative Space: Strategic breathing room in a dense grid

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Hero text

mono.usage: Logs, IDs, IP addresses, Status codes, Data tables

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs
Use Monospace for ALL numerical data and identifiers

strategies: Dashboard: Dense grid, 100% width utilization, no jagged bottoms
Landing: Asymmetric 'Tetris' grid, large typography, negative space
Forms: Single column max-w-md for focus, or split view with context

cards.style: Border-only (1px solid border-border), No shadow, bg-card

status_indicators.style: Glowing dot (w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-current shadow-[0_0_8px_currentColor])

effects: Tracing Beam: Animated gradient border for active deployments
Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10 (Header only)

assets.icons: Lucide React (default) or Phosphor Icons (for density)

images.description: Abstract dots pattern for subtle background texture
Server hallway for landing page hero or empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Retro-Futurism' theme: Dark backgrounds, neon accents, visible grids.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for all data/code.
Dashboard layout must be dense ('Control Room' grid). Avoid excessive whitespace in data views.
Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds or hero sections.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (text color change or border glow).
Use Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'sharp/tech' aesthetic (remove large rounded corners).
universal_guidelines: Create depth with z-index and subtle borders, not heavy shadows.
Micro-animations are mandatory for all interactions.
Use 2-3x more spacing in content containers (p-8, p-12) but keep data grids dense.
NEVER use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim.
